title: BRA-Audit: Budgeted Runtime Auditing for LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Cumulative-Exposure Audit-Point Placement
abstract: arXiv:2608.14668v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) solve complex tasks through specialized collaboration, but inter-agent dependencies can propagate hallucinated or malicious outputs into system-level failures. Auditor agents mitigate these risks, yet existing strategies face an efficiency dilemma: end-only auditing reviews long trajectories and final outputs, potentially weakening audit effectiveness and enlarging rollback scope, while auditing every agent each round improves detection and localization at high token cost. How can guard performance be preserved while minimizing token cost? To address this problem, we propose BRA-Audit, a budget-aware runtime auditing framework that models MAS execution as a dynamic dependency graph and formulates audit scheduling as audit-point placement under a fixed audit-call budget to minimize cumulative unchecked exposure. translated_title: BRA-Audit：基于累计暴露审计点放置的LLM多智能体系统预算运行时审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14668v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于LLM的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）通过专业化协作解决复杂任务，但智能体间的依赖关系可能将幻觉或恶意输出传播为系统级故障。审计智能体可缓解这些风险，但现有策略面临效率困境：仅末尾审计会审查长轨迹和最终输出，可能削弱审计有效性并扩大回滚范围；而每轮审计每个智能体虽能改善检测和定位，但会带来高昂的令牌成本。如何在保持防护性能的同时最小化令牌成本？为解决此问题，我们提出BRA-Audit，一种预算感知的运行时审计框架，它将MAS执行建模为动态依赖图，并将审计调度形式化为在固定审计调用预算下的审计点放置问题，以最小化累计未检查暴露。其贪心调度器优先处理有影响力且长时间未审计的区域，同时信任已验证的部分。
tldr: 本文提出BRA-Audit框架，通过动态依赖图和贪心审计点调度，在固定预算下最小化累计未检查暴露，平衡LLM多智能体系统的审计效率与令牌成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BRA-Audit, a budget-aware framework that uses dynamic dependency graphs and greedy audit-point scheduling to minimize cumulative unchecked exposure under a fixed budget, balancing audit efficiency and token cost in LLM multi-agent systems.
